ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central ventral surface with 15% low-intensity black pixels localized along the margins and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous white region. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and distal tips. Distinct black circular blobs are present on the far-left tip; a unique circular ring-shaped black mark is present on the far-right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression at the central junction of lobes, approximately 130 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke orientation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography. Left lobe displays deep macro-notches and jagged peaks. Right lobe shows a more frequent, lower-amplitude serration pattern across the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch to the pointed distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of dark circular pixel formations on the outer left lobe tip. A prominent, singular dark ring-shaped constellation is located on the outer right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the high-intensity white surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss or deep notching on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Unique 'O' shaped circular scar on the distal right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of a perfectly circular dark ring scar on the right lobe tip serves as a highly unique visual marker.
